'''Kella Antro''' was a [[human]] [[salt]] [[Merchant|trader]] from a [[Unidentified coastal town|coastal town]]. She supported her aging [[Kella Antro's parents|parents]] by delivering seasoning [[mineral]]s to the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] on the [[Planet|world]] [[Ueda]]. In [[132 BBY]], she was taken as a hostage in the [[noodle]] shop by the [[assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] during her [[Indara's murder|skirmish]] with [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]]. After Aniseya threw Antro from the shop's second floor, the [[Jedi]] saved her [[Force power|with]] [[the Force]].

==Biography==
{{Listen3|KellaAntro-Thrown-LostFound.flac|Kella Antro scream and whimper|Kella Antro screams as Mae-ho Aniseya throws her from a balcony, whimpering as Indara then catches her with the Force}}
Kella Antro was a [[human]] who came from a chilly [[Unidentified coastal town|coastal town]] and worked as a [[salt]] [[Merchant|trader]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. In order to support her aging [[Kella Antro's parents|parents]], she delivered seasoning [[mineral]]s to the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] run by the [[Drezar]] [[Cabuck]] in [[Point Ueda]],<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> a village on the [[Planet|world]] [[Ueda]].<ref name="Lomi Databank">{{Databank|lomi-usqi-noodle-shop|Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop}}</ref> In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> Antro visited the shop on the [[Standard day|day]] that the [[Sith assassin|assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] entered the building to [[Mae's quest|confront]] the [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]]. Aniseya began a fight with Indara's dining companions, starting a bar fight that caused most patrons to flee.<ref name="Episode I" />

[[File:KellaAntroHostage-LostFound.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=A masked Mae-ho Aniseya holds a knife to the throat of a terrified Kella Antro in the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop.|Kella Antro was held at knifepoint by Mae-ho Aniseya.]]
During the fight, Antro raced along the shop's second floor walkway as Aniseya leapt up to it from the ground floor. The [[assassin]] grabbed the merchant as a hostage, holding a [[Mae's knives|knife]] to her throat and causing Antro to gasp. Indara then rushed up to join them on the second floor, at which point Aniseya pushed Antro over the floor's railing and caused her to fall. Before the screaming salt merchant could hit the ground, Indara saved her [[Force power|with]] [[the Force]], stopping her descent in midair and letting her down to the floor gently. With Antro safe, the [[Jedi]] continued fighting the assassin, but was ultimately [[Indara's murder|killed]].<ref name="Episode I" />

==Personality and traits==
Antro had light skin, [[Color|gray]] [[eye]]s, and blond [[hair]] that she wore in [[braid]]s.<ref name="Episode I" />

==Equipment==
While at the [[noodle]] shop, Antro wore a brown-and-black heirloom [[Clothing|overcoat]] with a family crest woven into it.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> Her outfit also included a pair of black pants and brown [[boot]]s.<ref name="Episode I" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In this fight, I thought it was important to show that Mae's sort of testing Indara in her own way. She's making sure that Indara's always going to be a Jedi and that she's going to protect the innocent.|Christopher Clark Cowan discussing Indara and Mae's Ueda duel|audio=ChristopherClarkCowan-NoodleShop.flac|<ref name="Stunts-Noodleshop">{{SWYouTube|PJJpQCHNFZA|The Acolyte | Stunts - Noodle Shop | Disney+}}</ref>}}
Kella Antro first appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="Episode I" /> the first episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired [[June 4]], [[2024]] on [[Disney+]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The scenes in the shop were filmed at [[Shinfield Studios]],<ref name="Fantha Part I">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Julian Foddy">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}}</ref> [[Christopher Clark Cowan]]—the action designer and second unit director for ''The Acolyte''—wanted the duel to show that Aniseya was testing Indara to see if she would protect the innocent,<ref name="Stunts-Noodleshop" /> with the assassin targeting bystanders like Antro and Cabuck.<ref name="Episode I" /> Antro was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
